reasoning_content: The server is running and endpoints respond. Let me verify the documented login credentials actually work via POST login, and check the admin page content. Let me do a login flow with cookies.

action.command: cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt && TOKEN=$(curl -s -c cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in | grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); echo "token_len=${#TOKEN}"; curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o /dev/null -w "login status=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" --data-urlencode "user[email]=admin@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678" --data-urlencode "user[remember_me]=0"; echo "--- admin after login ---"; curl -s -b cj.txt -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/admin
